annotation.title_clean: Council Decision of 24 July 2012 on the position to be taken by the European Union within the Administrative Committee of the UNECE regarding the draft Regulation on Lane Departure Warning Systems and the draft Regulation on Advanced Emergency Braking Systems (2012/469/EU)
annotation.title_en: Council Decision of 24 July 2012 on the position to be taken by the European Union within the Administrative Committee of the UNECE regarding the draft Regulation on Lane Departure Warning Systems and the draft Regulation on Advanced Emergency Braking Systems (2012/469/EU)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 213/2
annotation.summary_en: EU Council Decision setting the Union's position to vote in favour of draft UNECE Regulations on Lane Departure Warning Systems and Advanced Emergency Braking Systems under the Revised 1958 Agreement, harmonising vehicle type-approval safety requirements and reducing technical trade barriers.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU to vote in favour of draft UNECE Regulation on Lane Departure Warning Systems
EU to vote in favour of draft UNECE Regulation on Advanced Emergency Braking Systems
Builds on Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 mandating these systems on certain vehicles
Enters into force on adoption, 24 July 2012
